rounds.answer:
The exact current marker is INTERVIEW-36-475838bfa755a687. This is a single-function JavaScript exercise: solve(nums,k) returns the kth largest value, counting duplicates.

Use a min-heap of size at most k: insert each number and, whenever its size exceeds k, remove the minimum. The invariant is that after each processed prefix, the heap contains its largest min(k, prefix length) values, including duplicate occurrences. Discarding the smallest of k+1 candidates preserves that invariant; at the end, the heap minimum is the kth largest value.

Time is O(n log(k+1)), with O(k) extra space. Boundary cases include k=1 (maximum), k=nums.length (minimum), a single element, duplicate or all-equal values, and negative numbers. Since k is guaranteed valid, no invalid-k handling is required. No implementation yet.
